title: the Egyptian mythos
audit_comment: THE EGYPTIAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round nine, print pp. 49-56: twenty-one beings (Ra the sungod, Anhur, Anubis, Apep, Apshai, Bast, Bes, the Flame Snake, Geb, Horus, Isis, Nephthys, Osiris, the Phoenix, Ptah, Seker, Set, the Minions of Set, Shu, Tefnut, Thoth), the temple and cleric-ladder doctrine, the true Ankh, and the 97-word hieroglyph grid riding as a data file. Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The adjudications: the GEOMETRY SWAP of the Ra and Anhur ability lines (the Termux psm-4 fold had them reversed; the IA x-coordinates plus the +14 lance prose settled Ra as the S:20 line and Anhur as the S:25(+7,+14)), Bast W:10 (the geometry word against the Termux W:70), the psionic classes (the II words of Anubis, Bast, Ptah and Set; the class I bars of Isis and Thoth; Osiris V; the eleven VI readers), the foot-mark size decodes (Isis 5 foot 4, Seker and Thoth 6 foot 4), the MR 59 of Set and the MR 69 of Shu and Tefnut (both voices agree on the odd print), and the flagged cells: the Horus 6 foot 2 size and 15/15 move, the Nephthys twin size decode, the Minions size, the Flame Snake xp line, and the hieroglyph AT word.

banner.title: the Egyptian mythos - the D&DG walk round nine, print pp. 49-56: twenty-one beings from Ra the sungod Pharaoh to the Gods to Thoth the teacher of the gods, the four monster races (Apep, the Flame Snake, the Phoenix, the Minions of Set), the true Ankh, and the 97-word hieroglyph grid, across twelve planes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 050-057; the second printing); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print, djvu.xml word geometry at 600dpi, segs 49-56). The adjudications: the GEOMETRY SWAP of the Ra and Anhur ability lines (the fold reversal caught by the x-coordinates and the +14 lance prose), Bast W:10 against the Termux W:70, the psionic classes by word geometry (the 46px, 29px and 28px II words against the Termux 11 and // garbles; the 9-10px I bars of Isis and Thoth), the foot-mark size decodes (Isis the printed 514 cell, Seker the 614, Thoth the 6%4 - the R853 lesson), and the odd MR prints (Set 59, Shu and Tefnut 69 - both voices agree). The flagged eyeball cells: Horus 6 foot 2 and the 15/15 move, the Nephthys twin size, the Minions size, the Flame Snake xp line, and the hieroglyph AT word.

tables.name: the combat grid
col_comments: The armor class cells (Ra -3, Anhur and Ptah -5, Thoth 4, Shu 6, Nephthys 2)
The range ceiling cells (0 = a single printed armor class; all twenty-one read single this round)
The hit point cells (400 the greater gods, down to 25 per Minion; 0 = the hit-dice Flame Snake row)
The primary move cells (-1 = the printed Infinite of Ptah, the R854 convention; 0 = none this round)
The secondary move cells (the printed slash ceilings; Horus the 15/15 decode - flagged)
The attack count cells (Ra the printed 0 with Nil damage, Apep 2, Osiris and Set 2, Phoenix 3)
The attack alternative cells (the 3/2 slashes of Anubis, Bes, Isis, Nephthys, Minions, Shu, Tefnut)
The magic resistance cells (Set the 59 and Shu/Tefnut the 69 - both voices agree on the odd print; 0 = the Phoenix printed See below)

The size cells in inches (the foot-mark decodes: Isis 5 foot 4 from the printed 514, Seker and Thoth 6 foot 4 from 614 and 6%4 - the R853 lesson; Apep 300 feet long, Geb 70 feet, Phoenix the 60 feet wingspread; Horus the flagged 6 foot 2, Nephthys the flagged twin decode, Minions the flagged 6 foot 4)

tables.name: the class grid
col_comments: The cleric level cells (Ra 20th, Anubis 20th, Isis the printed 20th cleric/14th druid slash, Ptah 20th, Thoth Nil)
The druid level cells (Isis the 14, Seker the in-each 13s; all others Nil)
The fighter level floor cells (the paladins Anubis 12, Horus via bool, Seker via bool, Shu via bool; 0 = the ranger-slot Osiris and the monster rows)
The fighter level ceiling cells (single printed levels read floor = ceiling)
The ranger level cells (Osiris the 16th level ranger)
The magic-user level cells (99 = the printed See below: Isis the unlimited 20th level doctrine; Ptah 25th, Set Nil over the 30th illusionist, Thoth the in-each 30s)
The illusionist level cells (Set the 30th level illusionist over a Nil magic-user; the in-each pairs of Anhur, Bast, Seker and Thoth)
The thief level cells (Bes the 15th level thief)
The assassin level cells (Anhur the 10th, Set the 15th level assassin)
The monk level cells (Anhur the 7th level monk)
The bard level cells (Bes the 8th, Osiris the 15th level bard)

tables.name: the ability grid
col_comments: The strength cells (the GEOMETRY SWAP: Ra the printed S:20 line and Anhur the S:25(+7,+14) - the Termux psm-4 fold had them reversed, the IA x-coordinates and the +14 lance prose settled it; Isis the printed S:10, Set 14, Shu and Tefnut the 16(0,+1))
The parenthesized strength to-hit bonus cells (0 = no printed bracket)
The parenthesized strength damage bonus cells (the +14s, the +12 of Osiris, the +9 of Ptah, the +1 of Shu and Tefnut)
The intelligence cells (the I:25s of Osiris, Ptah and Thoth; Nephthys the 1121 decode = I:21)
The wisdom cells (Bast the W:10 the IA geometry word against the Termux W:70; Anhur W:12)
The dexterity cells (the D:25s; Anubis 19)
The constitution cells (the 25s; Minions, Apep, Flame Snake and Phoenix read the all-sentinel line)
The charisma cells (Apshai the -3, Set the -2; the positive cells as printed - Thoth 18, Shu 19, Osiris 24, Horus 24)
The psionic score cells (0 = every being reads the R849 class table this round; no monster point scores printed)

tables.name: the roster grid
col_comments: The roster ordinal cells (the print order, Ra through Thoth)
The print page cells (49-55, the folio offset PRINT = PDF - 1; the hieroglyph grid pages 55-56 ride the data file)
The alignment cells (0 LG, 1 NG, 2 CG, 3 LN, 4 N, 6 LE, 8 CE - the R852 code scheme)
The rank cells (0 lesser, 1 greater, 2 demigod Apshai, 3 monster - Apep, the Flame Snake, the Phoenix, the Minions of Set)

The psionic class cells (1 Isis and Thoth, 2 Anubis, Bast, Ptah and Set - the 46px, 29px and 28px two-glyph geometry against the Termux 11 and // garbles, 5 Osiris, 6 the eleven VI readers - the R849 class table)

The plane cells (1 Prime Material, 2 Astral, 3 Gladsheim, 4 Concordant Opposition, 5 Elemental Earth, 6 Nirvana, 7 Olympus, 8 Elysium, 9 Ethereal, 10 Nine Hells, 11 Elemental Air, 12 Elemental Water; 0 = the monster rows, Apep the Abyss prose pinned as a bool)
The fixed-damage flags (1 = the printed DAMAGE/ATTACK cell is numeric damage; 0 = Ra Nil, Nephthys and the Phoenix-adjacent By weapon / See below rows of Nephthys, Minions, Shu, Tefnut and Thoth)
The in-each flags (the printed Nth level in each cells: Anhur MU/I, Bast MU/I, Bes MU/I, Seker C/D and MU/I, Thoth MU/I)
The Set-enmity flags (the printed enemy lines: Bast, Horus, Nephthys the abandoned wife, Osiris)
